exposure: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia)
Left atrial function (measured by 3D-STE and 2D-STE parameters: LASr, LAScd, LASct, LASrc, left atrial volume)
outcome: Adverse pregnancy outcomes (iatrogenic preterm delivery, admission to the neonatal intensive care unit, infants with small for gestational age)
cohort: A total of 94 pregnant women (comprising those with gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, and normotension) registered at Tiantan Hospital between August 2023 and October 2024.
finding: Pregnant women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy exhibit reduced left atrial function, and left atrial reservoir strain (LASr) measured by 3D-STE, along with systolic blood pressure, independently predicts adverse pregnancy outcomes.
